examples.arabic: قعدنا نتكلم شوية كتير عن اخبار العيلة والبلد
examples.english: We sat and talked a lot about family news and the country
examples.transliteration: Qaʿadnā netkallem shwaya kitīr ʿan akhbār el-ʿēla wel-balad

examples.arabic: مهم نختار رئيس الجمهورية اللي يقود البلد كويس
examples.english: It's important to choose the President of the Republic who will lead the country well.
examples.transliteration: Mohimm nekhtār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya elli yaʾūd el-balad kwayyis.

examples.arabic: بس زمان كان فيه احساس تاني بالحكم وان البلد دي بتاعتنا كلنا مش مجرد احزاب وخلاص
examples.english: But back then there was a different feeling about governance, and that this country was all ours, not just parties and that's it.
examples.transliteration: Bas zamān kān fīh eḥsās tānī bel-ḥokm w en el-balad dī betaʿetna kollena mesh mogarrad aḥzāb w khalas.
